messages.subject: Re: installation issue
parts:
I think I might know why now...

Your default Rprofile seems to load quite a few packages. Try starting
with an empty one, then install. Also make sure you have appropriate
permissions to read/write files in the unpacked rapache source
directory.

Jeff

messages.subject: Re: installation issue
parts:
Jeff,

I uninstalled and started all over using the debian quick install
method. I commented everything out of my Rprofile.site file and did a
chmod 777 on the rapache-1.1.9 folder. Apache seems to work fine and
it gives me the "It works" message from /var/www/index.html. Should I
have to make manual changes to get to it to feed me the rapache-1.1.9/
test/index.html file? I tried adding "Include /home/bosr/
rapache-1.1.9/test/httpd.conf" to the end of the /etc/apache2/
access.conf file but it still gives me only the "It works" message,
not the rapache index.html file. Can you think of anything else I can
try?

Thanks,

Roger

messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: Re: installation issue
parts:
I see now what you are doing. You aren't running "make itest"; you're
actually trying to run the test scripts after running "make install".

Start with this:

cd rapache-1.1.9
make itest

You should then see a message that says:

"Point your browser to http://localhost:8181/index.html"

See if that works.

Jeff
